_comment: SOURCE OF TRUTH for the Cloudflare http_request_cache_settings ruleset fronting the TC-ATLAS API (api.tcatlas.org). Apply with `python3 cloudflare/apply_cache_ruleset.py`; verify with `cloudflare/verify_cache.sh`. The auth token lives in GCP Secret Manager (secret `cloudflare-rules-token`); the zone_id/ruleset_id below are identifiers, not secrets. See README.md for the design rationale and CF API gotchas.

rules.description: tc-atlas: CACHE slow-changing JSON (active-storms, season-summary, weatherlab-genesis clusters/cluster/trend) respect origin max-age
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (http.request.uri.path contains "/active-storms" or http.request.uri.path contains "/season-summary" or http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-genesis-cluster" or http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-genesis-trend")

rules.description: tc-atlas: BYPASS live/no-store endpoints (weatherlab EXCEPT cacheable genesis clusters/trend)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (http.request.method ne "GET" or (http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab" and not (http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-genesis-cluster" or http.request.uri.path contains "/weatherlab-genesis-trend")) or http.request.uri.path contains "/recon" or http.request.uri.path contains "/shear")

rules.description: tc-atlas: CACHE frame endpoints (respect origin max-age)
rules.expression: (http.host eq "api.tcatlas.org") and (ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "band-raw-frame") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "ir-raw-frame") or ends_with(http.request.uri.path, "ir-frame.jpg"))
